```{r}
#| messsage: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
  
read_crops <- function(crop) {
  read_csv(str_c("data/raw/", crop, ".csv")) |> 
    filter(Period == "YEAR", County != "OTHER COUNTIES") |> 
    select(year = Year, state = State, county = County,
           stateID = `State ANSI`, countyID = `County ANSI`,
           `Data Item`, Value) |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Data Item`, values_from = Value)
}
  
wheat <- read_crops("wheat") |> 
  
soy <- read_crops("soybean") |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, production = `SOYBEANS - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU`)
corn <- read_crops("corn") |> 
  select(year, state, county, stateID, countyID, production = `CORN, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU`)
```

```{r}
crops |> 
  select(where(is.double), -year) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.double), names_to = "column") |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(colSums(is.na(crops))) |> 
  rownames_to_column() |> 
  select(column = rowname, num_NA = `colSums(is.na(crops))`)
  ) |> 
  filter(num_NA < 1000)


nrow(crops)
```
